Services.title: Tailored Solutions for Every Stage of Your Business
Services.subtitle: From rapid launch to enterprise e-commerce. Choose the package that aligns with your goals and scale when you're ready.

basic.title: Basic Package — Ultra-Fast Landing Page
basic.desc: Perfect for validating your idea, launching a product, or creating a professional online presence. This isn't just a static site — it's an optimized conversion machine.
basic.tech_stack: Next.js 15 + Vercel Edge Network + ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration)

features.1: Load time < 1 second (Vercel Edge CDN global)

basic.why_desc: ISR allows you to update text, prices, or images directly through an admin panel without needing a new deployment. The site remains ultra-fast (static) but with the flexibility of dynamic content.
basic.why_vercel: Vercel Edge Network ensures your site loads in milliseconds anywhere in the world — São Paulo, New York, or Tokyo.
basic.ideal_for: Ideal for: Startups, Freelancers, SaaS Products, Premium Portfolios

intermediate.title: Intermediate Package — Headless E-Commerce
intermediate.tagline: Shopify + Supabase: Best of Both Worlds
intermediate.desc: Combine Shopify's security and ease with a custom frontend's flexibility. You sell through the Shopify app, but your customers see a high-performance site.
intermediate.tech_stack: Next.js + Shopify Storefront API + Supabase (PostgreSQL) + Vercel
intermediate.why_desc: Shopify handles what it does best: payments, inventory, and logistics. Supabase adds features that basic Shopify doesn't offer — rich user profiles, browsing history, wishlists, custom reviews.
intermediate.why_supabase: Supabase provides a real PostgreSQL database with Row Level Security (RLS), ensuring your customers' data is protected at the row level.
intermediate.combo_power: The Combo: You get Shopify's reliability + the creative freedom of a custom app.
intermediate.ideal_for: Ideal for: Growing e-commerce, Fashion brands, Stores with 100-10k products

premium.title: Premium Package — Total Open-Source E-Commerce
premium.desc: Total control. Zero transaction fees. Your own database. This is the solution for those who want to scale without limits and without depending on third-party platforms.

features.6: Supabase Auth with Row Level Security

premium.why_desc: MedusaJS is open-source and free forever. You only pay for hosting (Railway or Render). Over time, you save thousands in transaction fees.
premium.why_supabase: Supabase manages your PostgreSQL with automatic backups, user authentication, and row-level security. Your customer data lives in a real database, not a third-party API.
premium.cost_breakdown: Estimated Monthly Cost: Railway/Render (~$20-50) + Supabase Free Tier (up to 500MB) = Less than $100/month to start.
premium.vs_shopify: Comparison: Shopify charges $79/month + 2% per transaction. If you make $10k/month, you pay $200 just in fees. With MedusaJS, you pay $100 fixed.
premium.ideal_for: Ideal for: High-volume e-commerce, Marketplaces, Companies needing complex integrations
